from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock market code (e.g., 000006)")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period, expected to be '2025-Q1' or similar")
    operating_revenue: float = Field(description="Operating Revenue for the period")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders for the period")
    net_operating_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net Operating Cash Flow for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the financials, e.g., 'CNY', '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData] = Field(description="List of companies and their financial data extracted from this document")
